name: Kev
description: Answers yes/no, multiple-choice, and rating questions about text with calibrated probabilities, for developers self-hosting a Jev-compatible decision API.

skills.name: Multi-Question Decisions
skills.description: Answers noul (yes/no), choice, and score questions about one text in a single request, each with probabilities.

skills.name: Jev-Compatible API
skills.description: Serves the System One API so the TypeSafe Python SDK works against a Kev server unchanged.

skills.name: Long Documents
skills.description: Accepts documents of up to 65,536 tokens on CUDA GPUs or on Apple Silicon through MLX.

skills.name: Fine-Tuning
skills.description: Fine-tunes a released checkpoint on your labelled examples, by hand or with the kev-finetune coding-agent skill on Modal.

skills.name: Endpoint Deploy
skills.description: Deploys an HTTPS endpoint on Modal with one command, behind a bearer key, scaling to zero when idle.
